verification_method: On 2026-09-20 the official Plone @@download/file endpoints reproduced every saved size, SHA-256, and container signature. The human-facing /view URLs returned anti-bot HTML to this environment, so they are retained as provenance URLs but not treated as file bytes. R2 accounting was read only; no proposed key exists in project-state/r2-inventory.json.

family_decisions.para_transit_minutes: Retain the three official minutes as a chronological Para-Transit Advisory Board record group on ABQ RIDE. They are actual minutes, not agendas; a current City search also demonstrates the board series continued. Preserve the OLE2 originals unchanged. The group is intentionally limited to the three recovered historical minutes; no fourth original was fabricated from the zero-byte City response.
family_decisions.paseo_del_bosque: Do not retain either item. The 2006 one-page map is low-context historical wayfinding and is eclipsed for public use by the validated 2020 full City guide. The purported guide is actually a one-page 2011 Tingley Beach public-art walking-tour PDF, not a Paseo del Bosque guide. Neither is a byte duplicate, so both are excluded rather than labelled duplicate or superseded.
family_decisions.city_service_programmes: Do not retain the three one-off service/programme items as static archive records. The Electrified Dealer overview is a one-page 2021 promotional handout while the live City programme page carries current information; the Convention Center directions are transient trip directions; and the Honored Citizen document is a transactional ID-card application form.
family_decisions.montano_station: Retain all six as one Montano Rail Runner Station project family, canonically under an ABQ RIDE Montano Station subsection. The traffic assessment is also useful on Roadway Studies, but the project family—not a generic studies page—is canonical. Present the two construction-plan packages as grouped design documentation, not equivalent standalone history entries. The EA remains explicitly DRAFT and the 46-sheet set explicitly 65% SUBMITTAL; Part II is a separately served 13-sheet companion, not a claimed final or synthetic combined plan set.
